information.title: Check-in time
information.answer: Check-in begins at 3:00 PM. The front desk is staffed around the clock for late arrivals.

information.title: Check-out time
information.answer: Check-out is by 11:00 AM on the departure date.

information.title: Wi-Fi
information.answer: Complimentary Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel and in every guest room.

information.title: Breakfast service
information.answer: A standard breakfast is served daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM and can be added to a room reservation.

information.title: Pet policy
information.answer: Pets are not permitted, except for trained service animals.

information.title: Guest parking
information.answer: Complimentary on-site parking is available for registered hotel guests, subject to availability.

information.title: Room categories
information.answer: The hotel offers Single Rooms for one guest, Double Rooms for two guests, Deluxe Rooms for up to three guests, and Family Rooms for up to four guests.

information.title: Hotel location
information.answer: Harbour Light Hotel is located at 18 Harbour Lane in Portland, Maine, a five-minute walk from the Old Port waterfront.

information.title: Accessibility
information.answer: The hotel has a step-free entrance, elevator access to every guest floor, and designated accessible rooms.

information.title: Front desk hours
information.answer: The front desk is staffed 24 hours a day, seven days a week.

information.title: Early check-in
information.answer: Early check-in may be available from 12:00 PM for a fee of 35.00 USD and must be confirmed by the front desk.

information.title: Late check-out
information.answer: Late check-out until 2:00 PM may be available for a fee of 40.00 USD and must be confirmed by the front desk.

information.title: Restaurant
information.answer: The Harbour Table restaurant serves dinner from 5:30 PM to 9:30 PM from Tuesday through Sunday.

information.title: Hotel bar
information.answer: The Lantern Bar is open daily from 4:00 PM to 11:00 PM.

information.title: Room service
information.answer: Room service is available daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 PM.

information.title: Electric vehicle charging
information.answer: Two electric vehicle charging spaces are available in the guest parking area on a first-come, first-served basis.

information.title: Service animals
information.answer: Trained service animals are welcome throughout the hotel at no additional charge.

information.title: Family services
information.answer: Baby cots and high chairs are available free of charge when requested before arrival.

information.title: Smoking policy
information.answer: All guest rooms and indoor public areas are non-smoking. A designated outdoor smoking area is available.

information.title: Housekeeping
information.answer: Daily housekeeping is provided between 9:00 AM and 3:00 PM. Guests may request a preferred service window.

information.title: Laundry service
information.answer: Paid same-day laundry service is available for items received at the front desk before 9:00 AM on weekdays.

information.title: Luggage storage
information.answer: Complimentary luggage storage is available on the arrival and departure dates.

information.title: Accepted payment methods
information.answer: The hotel accepts Visa, Mastercard, American Express, and Discover. Cash is accepted at check-out, but a payment card is required at check-in.

information.title: Standard cancellation policy
information.answer: Standard reservations may be cancelled without charge until 6:00 PM local hotel time two days before arrival. The rate selected at booking remains authoritative.

information.title: Public transport
information.answer: The nearest city bus stop is at Commercial Street and Franklin Street, approximately a four-minute walk from the hotel.

information.title: Airport transfer
information.answer: The hotel does not operate a shuttle. The front desk can arrange a taxi to or from Portland International Jetport.

information.title: Nearby attractions
information.answer: The Old Port waterfront, Portland Museum of Art, and Casco Bay ferry terminal are all within two miles of the hotel.

information.title: Hotel contact
information.answer: The front desk can be reached at +1-207-555-0140 or frontdesk@harbourlight.example.
